messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small PR to tidy the Optimize toolkit docs: fix dead links, add a compact SDK v2 snippet for batching+cache, and include a minimal quant profile example for small LLMs. Expect the linkchecker to flag a couple of legacy paths. @sasha @tyler please take a look
sasha: SG. Can you paste the exact snippet you plan to add so I can sanity-check formatting and phrasing?
morgan: Sure, here's the draft snippet (JS SDK v2):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood/efficient-small-v1',
  input: 'Summarize this doc in one sentence.',
  batching: { max_batch_tokens: 2048 },
  cache: { mode: 'prefix', max_prefix_kv: 4096 }
});
console.log(resp.text);
```
sasha: Looks good. Nit: add a one-line comment about latency vs cost for `max_batch_tokens`, and spell out that `cache.mode = prefix` keeps KV prefixes in memory.
tyler: For quant profiles, we should show an `int8` example and a short table of tradeoffs (latency vs mem vs quality). I can draft that section and a tiny eval prompt set to illustrate output delta.
jen: I'll open the PR and run the docs link-checker before merging. I'll also add a minimal smoke test prompt set so we don't accidentally regress quality in future. ETA EOD.
devex: Checklist reminder: 1) run `npm run docs:linkcheck` locally, 2) update SDK snippets under `docs/examples/sdk/js`, 3) include a changelog entry under Optimize -> Migration, 4) trigger staging deploy.
zaid: Heads-up — CI's link-checker already failed on `/old-opt/quant-profiles.html` in main. I added a redirect in my draft, but we should ensure the canonical path is `/optimize/quantization/profiles`.
morgan: Thanks, zaid — can you push the redirect patch to jen's PR branch or I can cherry-pick.
zaid: Pushed to jen/opt-docs-fix branch.
morgan: Great. Plan: jen opens PR by EOD, sasha reviews for clarity, tyler pushes quant profile commit, zaid verifies redirects, devex reruns link check, then merge if green. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: PR opened by jen: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234> (docs: optimize - snippet + link fixes)
morgan: I'll leave a short note in the PR about keeping snippet names backwards-compatible for existing users.
sasha: Also add a one-line migration checklist at the top of the Optimize guide — customers appreciate that.
morgan: Will do and link the new example under "Quick migration checklist". Done.
jen: PR is live and linkcheck passed on my machine, running staging deploy now. Will post status here when done.
docs-bot: staging deploy succeeded: <https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize>
jen: Deploy looks green, merging after couple approvals. Thanks everyone.
